name: raisedeck
description: Digitize fundraising and VC dealflow — decks, pipeline, data room, and investor updates in one place.

scripts.predev: prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts && next build
scripts.test: prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
